text: Confidence always pleases those who receive it. It is a tribute we pay to their merit, a deposit we commit to their trust, a pledge which gives them a claim upon us, a kind of dependence to which we voluntarily submit.
author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld
reference: Reflections; or Sentences and Moral Maxims
translation: J. W. Willis Bund and J. Hain Friswell, 1871
